rationale: The Dutch Raad van State decision concerns an administrative dispute (timeliness and rejection of a Wet openbaarheid van bestuur disclosure request) against a regional water authority (Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland) specifically seeking non-public records on the hydrological impacts (waterafvoer and watercompensatie) of constructing a Multifunctional Accommodation in Zwammerdam. Institutional transparency and accountability of a Dutch water board over water drainage and water compensation fall within water governance (waterboard_governance), though confidence is marked medium because the procedural vehicle is an FOI (Wob) request rather than a direct substantive Waterwet/keur permit review.
